description: Use this when someone asks how their brand shows up in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Google's AI overview) or on Google for the questions their buyers ask, which sites AI answers cite instead of them, or what those answers say: returns, for each question its buyers raise in the workspace's interviews with real people (most raised first), how many raised it, searches a month, where its site ranks on Google, and whether each AI answer cites it, names it or neither, with the sites they cite; plus totals and the sites AI answers cite most. Give a question's words to see only matching questions, with what each AI answer said. Measured each week by GatherHQ; it runs no research.

question.description: Words of a buyer question, e.g. "second opinion", to see only questions with all of them, with what each AI answer said.

name: gather_ai_answers
title: AI answers and search
